c6a68748: What is the name of Inazuma Eleven's main character?
Mark Evans (Mamoru Endou) is Raimon's goalkeeper and the protagonist of the series.
ae51a20e: What is Mark Evans's signature technique called?
God Hand is Mark's signature goalkeeping technique. He creates a giant hand to block shots.
1195f751: What is the national tournament in the first season called?
The Football Frontier is Japan's national school soccer tournament. Raimon takes part in it in season 1.
b988d256: What is the name of Axel Blaze's (Gouenji's) shooting technique?
Fire Tornado is Axel Blaze's signature shooting technique. He creates a tornado of fire around the ball.
17716275: What is the name of the alien team that invades Earth in season 2?
Alius Academy (Aliea Gakuen) is a supposedly alien school sending soccer teams to test and invade Earth.
75e12312: What is Jude Sharp's original Japanese name?
Jude Sharp (Yuuto Kidou) is Raimon's strategist, known for his special goggles.
d443d379: What is the name of the soccer team representing Japan in season 3?
Inazuma Japan is the Japanese national team formed for the FFI world competition (Football Frontier International).
643f1292: In which town is Raimon Junior High?
The main action takes place in the fictional Inazuma Town, in Japan.
88768a0a: What is the name of the controlling organization in Inazuma Eleven GO?
The Fifth Sector is the secret organization that controls soccer in Japan in the GO series.
4f3ddc0a: What is the name of the team that travels through time to save soccer?
Chrono Storm is the main team in GO Chrono Stone, traveling through time to save soccer.
f448c948: Who is Inazuma Japan's captain in the FFI?
Mark Evans remains Inazuma Japan's captain to represent Japan at the Football Frontier International.
38d60d82: What is the final part of the Inazuma Eleven GO trilogy called?
Inazuma Eleven GO: Galaxy is the third part of the GO series, in which a space team challenges Earth.
714a7a99: What is the standard size of a soccer team in Inazuma Eleven?
Just like in real soccer, an Inazuma Eleven team has 11 players on the field.
54c2ae38: What is the name of Raimon's ultimate rival school in season 1?
Zeus Junior High is season 1's ultimate team, almost unbeatable until the final against Raimon.
6dd87cfe: In which part does Raimon travel through time to save soccer?
GO Chrono Stone is the part in which Arion and his friends travel through time to prevent soccer from disappearing.
4bfd91ba: Which major international soccer tournament is at stake in the original season 3?
The FFI (Football Frontier International) is the world tournament pitting the best national school teams against each other.
95230271: Who is the main villain of Inazuma Eleven's season 1?
Ray Dark (Reiji Kageyama) is the manipulative coach who tries to destroy Raimon and control Japanese soccer in season 1.
802ddcf3: Which goalkeeping technique does Mark discover in his grandfather's notebooks?
Daisuke Evans's notebook describes God Hand as his legendary goalkeeping technique, inspiring Mark to learn it.
d1390a02: What is Victor Blade's (Tsurugi's) position at Raimon in GO?
Victor Blade (Tsurugi) is Raimon's best forward in GO — his aggressive style and iconic moves make him the most feared player of his generation.
0a200b91: What is the GO-exclusive ability that lets a player manifest their inner spirit called?
A Keshin is the manifestation of the player's soul — they summon their inner fighting spirit for superhuman performances in Inazuma Eleven GO.
914d294e: What is the name of the team representing Earth in GO Galaxy?
Earth Eleven is the team formed to take on the aliens in GO Galaxy — a planetary selection representing the whole Earth.
45f05c18: What is the technique that fuses a player with a legendary hero in Inazuma Eleven GO Chrono Stone called?
Miximax temporarily fuses a player with the aura of a great figure from the past — giving access to legendary techniques.
b95027cf: What is the name of Raimon's goalkeeper in GO, who succeeds Mark Evans?
Taichi Sangoku is Raimon's goalkeeper at the start of Inazuma Eleven GO.
1bef59d8: Which animation studio produced the Inazuma Eleven series?
The series is animated by studio OLM, also known for the Pokémon anime. It aired in Japan on TV Tokyo from October 2008.
99388f55: Which company created the Inazuma Eleven video games?
Level-5, the studio behind Professor Layton and Yo-kai Watch, created the Inazuma Eleven franchise.
89980266: On which console did the first Inazuma Eleven game come out, in Japan in 2008?
The first game, a mix of RPG and soccer, came out on Nintendo DS in 2008 in Japan and in 2011 in Europe.
7c319554: How many episodes does the original Inazuma Eleven series have over its three seasons?
The original series has 127 episodes: 26 for the national tournament, 41 for the Alius invasion and 60 for the world tournament.
8749f650: What threat hangs over Raimon's soccer club at the start of the series?
It will merge with Royal Academy
It is about to be shut down
The club has almost no players left and is about to be disbanded. Mark Evans, its goalkeeper, gathers teammates to save it.
acbc3c58: Which team, led by Ray Dark, does Raimon face in its very first match?
Royal Academy (Teikoku), the reigning champions, crush Raimon at first. The team is run behind the scenes by Ray Dark (Kageyama).
48d943e6: Why does Axel Blaze at first refuse to play soccer again?
He was expelled from his old school
His little sister is in a coma after an accident
Since the accident that left his little sister Julia in a coma, Axel has given up soccer. He returns to the field to help Raimon.
9a9f0282: Which Royal Academy technique does Mark try to stop with his God Hand, just before Axel joins the match?
Facing Royal Academy's Death Zone, Mark attempts his God Hand. Moved by his courage, Axel Blaze decides to step onto the field.
e34424d3: Which accessories are Jude Sharp's trademark?
Jude Sharp (Yuuto Kidou), a brilliant playmaker, always wears his goggles and his red cape.
b31ff4dc: Which Royal Academy player ends up joining Raimon after discovering Ray Dark's schemes?
Disgusted by Ray Dark's methods, Jude Sharp leaves Royal Academy and joins Raimon during the national tournament.
8dfcd8d1: Which new technique does Mark Evans master during the final against Zeus?
During the national final, Mark finally pulls off Majin The Hand, which lets Raimon fight back on the scoreboard.
8ccacd13: By what score does Raimon beat Zeus in the national final?
Trailing 3-0, Raimon turns the match around and wins 4-3 against Zeus to take the Football Frontier.
eebb4516: What is the job of Seymour Hillman, who becomes Raimon's coach?
Seymour Hillman (Seigou Hibiki) runs the Rairaiken ramen restaurant. A former goalkeeper of the legendary Inazuma Eleven team, he agrees to coach Raimon.
0db1ae62: What is the technique where Axel Blaze uses Jack Wallside as a springboard to shoot from high up called?
For the Inazuma Drop, Jack Wallside jumps and serves as a springboard for Axel, who strikes the ball from an impressive height.
67eb907c: What is the link between Celia Hills and Jude Sharp?
Celia Hills (Haruna Otonashi), Raimon's manager, is Jude Sharp's little sister. They were separated as children through adoption.
5ca71e30: In which region of Japan does Raimon recruit Shawn Froste in season 2?
Shawn Froste (Shirou Fubuki), a player from the snowy north, joins Raimon in Hokkaido to take on Alius Academy.
2427748d: Where does the Alius Academy players' power come from?
The Alius players are not aliens but children whose abilities were enhanced by a mysterious meteorite.
4191487d: Which is the last Alius Academy team that Raimon must beat?
After Gemini Storm, Epsilon and others, Raimon faces The Genesis, Alius's strongest team, led by Gran.
f97b0411: Which player is hiding behind Gran, captain of The Genesis?
Gran is actually Xavier Foster (Hiroto Kiyama), raised by the man who founded Alius Academy.
fccd900b: With which team technique does Raimon beat The Genesis?
For the final battle against The Genesis, Raimon develops a new team technique, The Earth.
0cf93afa: Who is appointed coach of Inazuma Japan for the world tournament?
Percival Travis (Michiya Kudou), father of the manager Camelia, is chosen as Inazuma Japan's coach.
e724033b: On which island is the final stage of the FFI world tournament held?
The final stage of the Football Frontier International is played on Liocott Island, where each country has its own district.
677ee15f: Against which team does Inazuma Japan play the world tournament final?
After beating The Kingdom (Brazil) in the semifinal, Inazuma Japan wins the final against Little Gigant.
61b1b92c: Who is the hero of Inazuma Eleven GO, ten years after the original series?
In Inazuma Eleven GO, Arion Sherwind (Tenma Matsukaze) enters Raimon Junior High to play soccer.
d22d90aa: What role does Mark Evans have in Inazuma Eleven GO?
As an adult, Mark Evans returns to Raimon as coach to free soccer from the Fifth Sector's control.
f35ec481: What is the national tournament rigged by the Fifth Sector in Inazuma Eleven GO called?
The Fifth Sector decides the results of the Holy Road in advance. Raimon rebels against this system.
